title: Load the smallest set of documents that answers the question
prompt: Where does the outbox retry backoff live, and what must I read before changing it?
expectedBehavior: Start from .ai/CONTEXT.md, then the topic memory file, then the specific spec
Use the context manifest to map the changed paths to docs, specs, skills and commands
Read only the files the task needs; avoid dumping the whole repository
Cite the file and line range that answers the question
prohibitedBehavior: Restating AGENTS.md in full instead of pointing to it
Running repomix on the whole repository for a single question
criteria: The answer names the file that owns the behavior
The manifest output is used, not guessed
